Oneliner

Water level and water quality monitoring of medium-to-large sweet water reservoirs in Africa.

Description

Water level and water quality monitoring of medium-to-large sweet water reservoirs in Africa. Education of students in CubeSat design, and water management. Precursor to 4 spacecraft constellation. VTT Fabry-Perot interferometer based hyperspectral imager. Deliver critical data directly to national water resource centers in Africa with an unmatched cost per pixel ratio and high temporal resolution.
